findings.reason: the section must add docs/state/reckon/suite-runs/ to its write paths or drop "committed", or the node cannot satisfy its own measure and stops on a scope refusal rather than on a defect.
findings.text: §7's done-when requires "the measurement's committed row under docs/state/reckon/suite-runs/" while its declared write paths are only tests/conftest.py, tests/spa_browser_harness.py, reckon/crew/standing_suite.py, docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml and tests/test_browser_population_is_its_own_row.py, so a node granted exactly those paths is fenced out of committing the row its own done-when demands

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — resolving extensionless hrefs as `<path>.html` per the house convention, the-suite-is-green-at-head resolves; the cited symbols and files exist at the snapshot (installed_browser_or_skip at tests/spa_browser_harness.py:539, module_reaches_the_browser_harness and pytest_collection_modifyitems at tests/conftest.py:59/1148, record_from_log at reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:306, review_populations at reckon/flight.py:930).
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §7's done-when requires a committed artifact on a path its declared write paths omit (docs/state/reckon/suite-runs/), and the negative control it names is genuine (removing the marker exclusion makes a marked test appear, so the exclusion assertion fails).
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the quiet-node measurement, its two arms and the committed row all sit on durable paths (the run directory and the git-tracked docs/state/reckon/suite-runs/), not a scratchpad or a node-local temporary directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the section carries no plan labels, stage names, ticket numbers or version tags into the source it names; the gate id g-tstb-browser-row and the comment id c-hold-s2-1010 appear only as plan-document references, not as symbols or comments in the code paths §7 writes (tests/conftest.py, tests/spa_browser_harness.py, reckon/crew/standing_suite.py).
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the §7 preamble matches comment c-hold-s2-1010 (head 866.8 s against base 190.3 s; 32 of 33 failures Timeout (>20.0s); base arm at 60 s), the collection hook that applies the marker exists in tests/conftest.py and is what the redefined population rests on, and the row-writing mechanism runs on the real path: `reckon crew suite run` records one row per declared population (reckon/crew_run_commands.py:1101-1109), with §7 stating the project layer declares no browser population until §9 supplies it.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §7 carries one deliverable: the browser population marked at collection, excluded from the standing-suite command, and recorded as its own row; the measurement and its row are the same deliverable's evidence, not a second one.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — the §2↔§7 ordering is recorded by gate g-tstb-browser-row (data-section="s2", data-gated-sections="s2", required-evidence "the-suite-tests-behaviour#s7"), which matches §7's "§2's completion is gated on this section's evidence"; every path and anchor §7 cites resolves (tests/conftest.py, tests/spa_browser_harness.py, reckon/crew/standing_suite.py, docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml, tests/test_browser_population_is_its_own_row.py, record_from_log at standing_suite.py:306, comment c-hold-s2-1010, the-suite-is-green-at-head).
